params.name: aTable
params.description: Table from which to create the selection

params.name: recordArray

elementTypeSelectsMode.Integer array: each element is an absolute record number to include in the selection
elementTypeSelectsMode.Boolean array: the Xth element (True/False) indicates whether record number X belongs to the selection

params.description: Array of record numbers, or array of booleans indicating per-record membership

params.name: selectionName
params.default: applies to the current selection if omitted or an empty string
params.description: Name of the named selection to create

overloads.semanticRole: Builds a named selection (or updates the current selection) for a table from either an array of record numbers or a parallel array of per-record booleans.

constraints: If selectionName is omitted or an empty string is passed, the command updates the current selection instead of creating a named selection.
With a Longint/Integer array, all values must be distinct valid record numbers; a duplicate or invalid (not-created) record number generates error -10503.
With a Boolean array, elements are read from index 0 to N-1 and the array length should equal the table's record count; if shorter, only the records covered by the array can be part of the selection.
Record numbers can be reused after a record is deleted and a new one created, so a stale Integer array of record numbers can silently select the wrong records.
